name: shiny-button
title: Shiny Button
description: A shiny button component with dynamic styles in the dark mode or light mode.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ShinyButton } from '@/components/ui/shiny-button'
</script>

<template>
  <ShinyButton>Shiny Button</ShinyButton>
</template>

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the button. Motion props (`transition`, `animate`, …) pass through to override the shine.

emits.name: click
emits.description: Native click (falls through to the button).
